entities.summary: The Vinschgau Railway is a standard gauge, single-track railway in South Tyrol, Italy. The 60-kilometre-long (37 mi) railway runs from Meran west to Mals (Malles) through the Vinschgau, the upper valley of the river Etsch (Adige). SAD Nehverkehr conducts rail transport operations on the railway, and Südtiroler Transportstrukturen (STA) is the railway infrastructure manager.
